stories.title: Mike Tomlin reveals the Minecraft city he built for 12 years
stories.summary: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin, now an NBC analyst, posted a nearly 20-minute YouTube tour of a Minecraft city he has worked on since 2014, complete with penthouses, stadiums and a worry about enough public bathrooms. His announcement post on X passed 20 million views and the video doubled its views overnight, while fans joked about his urban-planning cadence and rivals like the Browns trolled the Steelers with Minecraft memes.
